dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: Ahem... "Melodious night breeze, be my words, express the daylight delights"...

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: "Here I stand in the wind, just to hear your gentle sing-along."

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: What do you think of that?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: What do I think of what?

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: The lovely poem I just composed. How does it make you feel?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Is this... for your literature class?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't quite get it...

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: I can barely keep my eyes open... When will he stop?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Oh, because of somebody, I don't get enough sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: He's forcing me to spend too much time with him every night. It would be fine if we just go to the bar, but he just makes me to listen to gibberish by the side of the road.

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: If I liked hearing other people read, I'd go to a lecture!

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: Could it be that he's insinuating I should read more!?

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: I didn't know that it's this tedious to date a bookworm!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Hana
dialogues.text: If only I could sleep standing up like Hakan...
